hero.badge: AI Mentoring · Method designed by a human team
hero.title: Tell it what's blocking you.
hero.titleHighlight: Walk away with a concrete next step.
hero.subtitle: Three Billion Heartbeats is an AI mentor that listens without judgment, detects where you are (stuck, anxious, clear) and gives you a real action in under 10 minutes. The AI is the tool. A human team designs the method and supervises the system.
hero.bullet1: Write what's going on — no filters, no forms
hero.bullet2: Detects your state and adapts the conversation
hero.bullet3: Ends with an actionable next step for today
hero.langNote: AI mentoring in English. Not a replacement for therapy.

features.title: Every heartbeat, a step forward
features.subtitle: A mentorship that understands where you are and walks with you toward action, heartbeat by heartbeat.

noJudgment.title: No judgment
noJudgment.description: Only questions that move you forward. No unsolicited advice, no evaluations, no pressure.

realState.title: Real state
realState.description: Detects if you're blocked, anxious, or clear and adapts the conversation to where you really are.

concreteAction.title: Concrete action
concreteAction.description: Every conversation ends with a real next step you can execute today in under 10 minutes.

step1.title: Describe how you feel
step1.description: No filters, no judgment. Tell Three Billion Heartbeats what's happening, what you're avoiding, what's holding you back.

step2.title: Get clarity
step2.description: Blocked, anxious, doubtful, or clear — the conversation adapts to where you are.

step3.title: Act in under 5 min
step3.description: A concrete, actionable next step that generates real momentum starting today.

team.title: We're not a loose AI
team.subtitle: The AI runs a method we designed, supervise and improve every week. This is not a generic chatbot: it's a system with named people accountable for it.

aiRole.title: The AI
aiRole.description: Reads what you write, detects your state, returns questions and next steps. Fast, available anytime, no judgment.

humanRole.title: The human team
humanRole.description: Designs the pedagogical method, reviews anonymized conversations, tunes the system and decides when something needs a real professional.

founder.name: Mario Pablo Sánchez Barrón
founder.bio: I design the method, supervise the system's behavior and personally answer support email.

advisor.name: Amaya Prado
advisor.bio: Psychologist specialized in childhood, adolescence and youth, with 20+ years in psychological intervention, family counseling and educational psychology. Preventive and integrative approach. Regular contributor to national media.

team.transparency: We do not read your conversations in real time. We review anonymized samples to improve the system, and the clinical criteria is reviewed with professional advisory. If anything borders on crisis or therapy, we tell you and refer you. We don't play psychologist.

item1.title: It's not therapy
item1.description: It does not replace a psychologist or clinical intervention. If you're in crisis, we refer you.

item2.title: It's not generic ChatGPT
item2.description: It's a system with method, guardrails and human supervision. Not loose advice or book summaries.

item3.title: It's not motivational coaching
item3.description: No pretty quotes or empty affirmations. Concrete questions and a real step for today.

finalCta.title2: The ones ahead are still yours.
finalCta.subtitle: Three billion heartbeats in a lifetime. How many passed without you feeling them?
finalCta.disclaimer: Does not replace therapy or professional psychological intervention.

chatMockup.msg1User: I've been stuck on my project for weeks
chatMockup.msg2Ai: What's the smallest thing you could do in the next 10 minutes?
chatMockup.msg3User: I guess open the file and write a paragraph
chatMockup.msg4Ai: That's exactly what you need. Do it now. Then tell me about it.
